top_signals.title: DP World CEO Says Massive Opportunities in India
top_signals.summary: DP World Group CEO Yuvraj Narayan says economic growth is driving massive opportunities in India. Speaking with Bloomberg's Haslinda Amin on the sidelines of the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi, Narayan noted that as the world diversifies away from traditional sources of supply, India offers major potential across its entire supply chain infrastructure. (Source: Bloomberg)
